svg.title: Continuous Recovery Readiness
svg.desc: Editable 800 by 450 vector dashboard. Readiness posture is 96 percent, with a four percentage point upward trend. Five readiness checks, two recommended actions, a continuous validation cycle, and three key indicators. All motion repeats continuously. Text, shapes, icons, paths, and charts are individual editable vector objects. Fonts are embedded; no external files or raster images are used.
